userStories.title: Agent Loop + Typed Events (Claude Code parity foundation)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a Claude-Code-style async-generator agent loop with typed streaming events and concurrency-safe tool orchestration so parallel reads are fast and writes serialize correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/core/src/agent/loop.ts` exports `runTurn()` returning `AsyncGenerator<AgentEvent, TurnDone>`
`packages/core/src/agent/events.ts` exports the discriminated union `AgentEvent = TextChunk | ThinkingChunk | ToolStart | ToolEnd | PermissionRequest | TurnDone`
`packages/core/src/agent/state.ts` exports the Turn state type (messages, toolResults, tokenBudget, continuationReason)

`packages/core/src/agent/tools/orchestration.ts` exports `batchAndRun(toolCalls)` which partitions by `Tool.isConcurrencySafe()`, runs read-only batches with `Promise.all` capped at `LIGMA_MAX_TOOL_USE_CONCURRENCY` (default 10), serializes writes
One failing tool in a read-only batch does NOT poison the batch (other tools' results are preserved)
AbortSignal propagates into in-flight tools and short-circuits the batch
`packages/core/src/agent/tools/fs-read.ts` and `fs-write.ts` delegate to main via the IPC-ACK contract from W1 (import — do not modify)
`packages/providers/src/claude-cli/sdk-to-agent-events.ts` adapts SDK stream events (from `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`) to the AgentEvent stream
`packages/core/src/agent/index.ts` re-exports both the new loop API AND the existing `packages/core/src/agent.ts` public surface — zero caller regressions (callers keep working without change)
UI exposes a new 'Run with new loop (beta)' button that invokes `runTurn` end-to-end for the golden-path smoke test
Vitest: orchestration — 15 read-only tools cap at 10 concurrent; writes serialize; one failure leaves other results intact; abort propagates
Vitest: loop — yield interleaving of Text/Tool events; `TurnDone` emitted when appropriate; abort handling
Vitest: end-to-end — mock SDK stream → `sdk-to-agent-events` → `runTurn` → expected AgentEvent sequence
